actions.reason: K4_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity from two complementary sources: coordinated OXPHOS/complement/interferon down-regulation (RNA, ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e5313ac502) and a PBRM1-high/VHL-enriched, BAP1-depleted mutation profile (WXS, ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:e5313ac502). Membership representation is weak-to-conflicting (CT reversed, RNA/WSI marginal, WXS modest; ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e5313ac502), but the relevant boundaries are not broadly unsupported: the K4_C0001–K4_C0002 pair shows a coherently represented current boundary (within ~0.50 vs between ~0.16, ARI ~0.78) with a non-single-cluster union (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:e51ef3599a), and the K4_C0001–K4_C0004 pair shows a strongly represented boundary (ARI 1.0) with a single-cluster-dominated union that is merge-compatible rather than boundary-supporting (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:aad94ea7bd). No feasible internal subdivision is supported (single-cluster dominated, ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:e5313ac502), and confounder associations are only nominal and do not survive correction (ER:...confounder_association:set:e5313ac502). The candidate remains a defensible independent discovery-stage unit.

K4_C0002 has a coherent biological identity from complementary sources: coordinated OXPHOS/protein-secretion/fatty-acid/mTORC1 up-regulation (RNA, ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e) and a VHL-low/PBRM1-low mutation profile directionally distinct from K4_C0001 (WXS, ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e). Membership representation is coherently unsupportive (all four native views reversed; ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fc5a03698e), and confounder associations with site and CT acquisition factors are present (ER:...confounder_association:set:fc5a03698e). However, the relevant boundaries are not broadly unsupported: the K4_C0002–K4_C0003 pair shows a coherently represented current boundary (within 0.57 vs between 0.19, ARI 0.85) with a non-single-cluster union (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:901823f7b2), and the K4_C0001–K4_C0002 pair likewise shows a represented boundary (ARI ~0.78; ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:e51ef3599a). No internal subdivision is supported (single-cluster dominated; ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:fc5a03698e). Given the substantive biological identity and the represented boundaries, the candidate remains a defensible independent unit rather than a drop.

K4_C0003 has a coherent biological identity from complementary sources: coordinated immune/inflammatory up-regulation (allograft rejection, IFN-gamma/alpha, IL6/JAK/STAT3; RNA, ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5) and a BAP1-high/PBRM1-low mutation profile distinct from K4_C0001 and K4_C0002 (WXS, ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5). Membership representation is conflicting and modality-dependent (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:42fb02ccf5), and site/CT acquisition confounders survive correction (ER:...confounder_association:set:42fb02ccf5). The relevant boundaries are nonetheless represented: the K4_C0002–K4_C0003 pair shows a coherent current boundary (ARI 0.85; ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:901823f7b2) and the K4_C0003–K4_C0004 pair shows the strongest within-side affinity and lowest normalized-cut cost with ARI ~0.88 (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:72cd572bc2). No internal subdivision is supported (single-cluster dominated; ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:42fb02ccf5). The candidate remains a defensible independent discovery-stage unit.

K4_C0004 has a coherent biological identity from complementary sources: stromal/proliferative and signaling up-regulation (UV-response-DN, hedgehog, mitotic spindle, EMT, TGF-beta) with OXPHOS down-regulation (RNA, ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:6e0bda1ea1) and a VHL-high/PBRM1-absent mutation profile distinct from K4_C0002 and K4_C0003 (WXS, ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:6e0bda1ea1). Membership representation is conflicting (WXS strongly supportive, RNA/WSI reversed; ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:6e0bda1ea1), but no measured technical/acquisition factor shows significant association (ER:...confounder_association:set:6e0bda1ea1). The relevant boundaries are represented: the K4_C0003–K4_C0004 pair shows the strongest within-side affinity and lowest normalized-cut cost with ARI ~0.88 (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:72cd572bc2), and the K4_C0001–K4_C0004 pair shows a strongly represented boundary (ARI 1.0) with a single-cluster-dominated union that is merge-compatible rather than boundary-supporting (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:aad94ea7bd). No internal subdivision is supported (single-cluster dominated; ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:6e0bda1ea1). The candidate remains a defensible independent discovery-stage unit.
